comment: * A way to construct {@link java.net.HttpURLConnection}s that supports some * configuration on a per-factory or per-connection basis rather than only via * global static state such as {@link java.net.CookieHandler#setDefault(java.net.CookieHandler)}. * The per-factory configuration is optional; if not set, global * configuration or default behavior is used. * * This facade prevents tight coupling with the underlying implementation (on * top of a particular version of OkHttp). Android code outside of libcore * should never depend directly on OkHttp. * * This abstraction is not suitable for general use. Talk to the maintainers of * this class before modifying it or adding additional dependencies. * * @hide * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API
